name: B10-0483/2026 (ESN) – Escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is an opinion, not a law. The European Parliament says it is seriously worried about fighting in the Black Sea, which is hurting shipping, trade and food supplies. It calls on all sides to show restraint and stop putting lives and ships at risk. It wants the European Union to talk to everyone involved, support peace efforts, and help Black Sea countries work together on trade, transport and energy without pushing them to join the European Union.

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Black Sea countries, shipping companies, ports and energy suppliers.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and national parliaments for their attention.
